text:
maria: Quick planning note — I want to run a 30m pre-cut sync next week to confirm readiness, owners, and the rollback plan. Need folks who will own canary, infra, schema, and QA.
sachin: +1. prefer Tue morning (PST) but can do Wed afternoon if needed.
alex: I can lead canary + smoke tests. Will have a 5-min checklist ready.
jordan: heads up — I have a calendar conflict Tue 10–11 PST. Wed 2pm works for me.
emily: linking runbook and current blocker list: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-42
maria: options — Tue 9:30am PST, Tue 11:30am PST, Wed 2pm PST. Please reply with which slot or "no".
alex: prefer Tue 9:30am PST.
sachin: Tue 11:30am PST for me (earlier is tight).
jordan: Wed 2pm for me.
emily: I can do any slot except Tue 9:30.
maria: ok leaning Wed 2pm to maximize attendees. Agenda draft below — please call out missing items.
ops-bot: Reminder: add required stakeholders to calendar invite (SRE, Infra, Security reviewer) :bell:
maria: Agenda (30m):
```
- Quick roll status (2m) — release owner
- Open blockers (5m) — each owner 1m
- Canary plan & metrics (6m) — canary lead
- DB/schema migration plan + cutover window (5m)
- Rollback and hotfix playbook (5m)
- RFC/design handshake for new routing change (3m)
- Action items + owners (4m)
```
maria: Assign owners here please: canary=alex, infra=sachin, QA=emily, schema=jordan, release-owner=maria
alex: I'll post the canary checklist in #eng-releases before EOD Monday. snippet:
```
- deploy canary to 5% traffic
- run smoke suite
- monitor latency p95, error-rate, KV cache hit
- validate model outputs on sample prompts
```
sachin: infra note — we'll need a warm pool for 10% burst capacity. I'll confirm instance types and cost delta in the invite.
emily: QA will prepare a focused regression pack (10 tests) and a short checklist for production verification.
jordan: schema migration: zero-downtime approach ready, but need a DB owner during the cut. @maria can you confirm?
maria: yes i'll be DB owner during the cut.
sachin: tagging security — @security to confirm no outstanding review on telemetry changes.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: Wed 2026-03-25 14:00 PST — invite sent to listed participants.
maria: thanks all. If you can't make it, add a proxy and post any pre-reads. I'll attach slides + short notes 24h before.
alex: ping for code review: PR #4821 (routing fallback) needs one more review before canary. @sachin @emily pls take a look.
emily: will review by EOD Mon.
sachin: will review after infra confirmation.
maria: final ask — on the call, each owner should have a single-slide status: GO / WATCH / BLOCK, and an explicit rollback criterion. keeps the sync fast. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Attach runbook snapshot: release-42-runbook-v3.pdf (auto)
maria: perfect. See you Wed 2pm PST.
